noticeSummary: The current indexed organiser results page states that result lists are protected and may be viewed solely for private informational purposes. It refers readers to the organiser's general terms.
evidenceLimit: The current indexed page contains this notice; the older cached direct rendering omitted it. The linked participation-terms landing page is not itself a third-party data reuse grant.
requiredNextEvidence: Documented source permission or an applicable licensed feed/export covering athlete-profile use, historical records and the intended social leaderboard use.
separateTechnicalBlocker: The connected browser stopped at its cost limit before returning any new age-30 or age-35 rows. Direct result-host extraction was also unavailable. No missing row is inferred from this failure.
existingArtwork: Four previously produced Berlin draft cards exist in the user's private workspace. They remain unofficial and have not acquired a third-party reuse approval through this source registration.
scope: Berlin result-list source only. Do not generalise this finding to every mika:timing client or unrelated race organiser.
